meta.note: Tiered DTCG-2025.10 structure (primitive -> semantic -> component). Migrated 2026-08-13 from the flat v3.1 file. Structural migration only: every shipped VALUE survives unchanged; only primitive step NAMES were re-seated from measured CIE L* (see $extensions.provenance on each primitive). The x.brandkit namespace is provisional (Decision 1) — when the product is named, rename meta.extensionsNamespace AND sweep the 'x.brandkit' key globally.
meta.sourceOfTruth: The production marketing site. Values EXTRACTED from shipped CSS, not designed here. See INVENTORY.md; non-token rules/anatomy/voice live in references/.

migration.stepReseat: Primitive steps assigned by measured L* within hue family (lighter=lower). The schema doc's step numbers were eyeballed estimates and were NOT reused. Examples: green fill re-seated .500->.400, green ink .700->.600, teal .500->.400 / .700->.600, coral/punch ->.300, red fill ->.500, gray ->.700.
migration.nonTokenContent: systemRules, voice, component anatomy, illustration/motif prose relocated to references/*.md.

slide.$description: Tier-3 deck component tokens — the atomic slide system (Phase 2R). Extracted from '2026 This Waay Deck Template'. DECK-SCOPED bindings: the deck's accent is TEAL (eyebrows, subheads, timed-rows, numerals, Opportunity/Sub-Category pills); GREEN (fill.action) is reserved for divider-words, gantt bars, Category pills, and the closing word. Every atom references a SEMANTIC role — no literal. Note: this template uses NAVY headers (text.body/on-ground), not the legacy slideDeck 'Deck Gray' — the old gray-header rule is superseded by the real template; see references/slide-components.md.
